name: Dart
idea: The slot inside the teal C and a notch cut into the N line up into one forward arrow that flies from the symbol into the wordmark.
why: Like the FedEx arrow it hides in the letters until you notice it, and after that the dart shooting from C into N is the first thing you see.
risks: The arrowhead needs a notch cut into the N, so the N is a modified letter, and electric teal on a white van is light, so small text should stay in Ink.
